subject: D-RUG and Tea Time this Thursday, plus #maptimeDavis open mic

messages.author: 532359cb4f30370a
messages.subject: D-RUG and Tea Time this Thursday, plus #maptimeDavis open mic
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies! 

In addition to the regular meeting this week, you are also encouraged to join #maptimeDavis on Friday for a lightning talk session. The lightning talks will be in room 1025 of the Physical and Data Sciences building between 10am-noon on Friday. Signups are here: https://forms.gle/2s7K2DAJmcmWeKsU6

As usual, D-RUG will be meeting this Thursday from 10-noon virtually and in person in the DataLab classroom (Library 360). This is a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and get in some distraction free R-coding time. Additionally, if there are topics you would like to see someone do a deeper dive on, let us know! 

There is also Tea Time in the DataLab classroom from 1-2pm Thursday if you are looking to take a break from work with tea (or coffee) and cookies. 

Zoom at this link: https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
